messages:
elena: Thanks everyone 9 dropping the follow-up thread for todays all-hands. Post questions about mission, positioning, market signals, or how to handle competitor conversations. Ill check in through the afternoon.

jonas: quick one for enablement: whats the single-sentence opener vs hyperscalers for procurement?
priya: product ask: can leadership confirm the top 3 rollout features we should highlight to customers?
tony: sales ask: do we have a public % target for Dedicated/Private contribution to new logos this fiscal? reps want a band.
gabi: eng question: any recommended short perf blurb we can quote for p95 on common configs?
elena: Short answers:
- opener for procurement: "Redwood: one developer API, SLA-backed performance, and private deployments to avoid lock-in." Keep it benefits-first.
- top rollout features: 1) canary deployments + automated rollback, 2) pinned model variants, 3) traffic policies & region failover.
- target band: internal target ~26%-31% of new-logo ACV from Dedicated/Private this fiscal.
- perf blurb: "Typical p95 for mid-size models on verified configs: ~80-200ms depending on seq length and caching." We'll publish a tighter table next week.

jonas: should enablement call out hyperscalers by name in decks? some reps want explicit comparisons.
priya: follow-up: whats our public-facing stance on benchmarks vs open models? do we publish detailed numbers?
elena: Guidance: internal enablement may include direct competitor comparisons. Public docs should be product-first and benefits-focused. We will publish high-level benchmark summaries and reproducible tests for community trust; detailed lab runs remain internal.

tony: pricing guidance: any walk-away price floors for sales to use?
elena: We'll publish price ranges for typical Dedicated tiers (small/med/large) in enablement. Final pricing stays deal-specific. Reps should lead with differentiation (SLOs, private deploy, rollouts) before price.

gabi: for engineers: are we updating defaults for long-context workloads (8k+)? caching on by default?
elena: Recommend KV/prefix caching + dynamic batching as defaults; quantization only after quality checks. Runtime docs will be updated with a short playbook.

ops-bot: Recording + slides uploaded: https://redwood/ah/1898765432

jonas: thanks 3 i'll update the sales one-pager with the procurement line.
priya: i'll add the rollout feature bullets to the product FAQ.
tony: i'll sync with sales ops to get the price ranges into CRM once posted.
gabi: need the perf table to update docs; ping me when live.
elena: I'll drop the one-pager, the perf snapshot, and the canary roadmap excerpt by EOD. Thanks for the great questions :raised_hands:
